title: Phytochemicals Targeting Wnt/beta-Catenin in Osteoblasts: Mechanisms, Scaffolds, and Computational Insights for Bone Therapeutics.
authors: Shah, Aarti Abhishek; Goswami, Anupam; Dev, Kapil; Hingorani, Lal; Maurya, Rakesh; Srivastava, Kinshuk R; Chattopadhyay, Naibedya
one_liner_zh: 该文聚焦植物化学物与Wnt/β-catenin通路蛋白的分子对接，用于骨治疗，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或MD方法，仅常规对接，与TF-DNA课题关联极弱。
abstract: The Wnt/beta-catenin signaling pathway is pivotal for osteoblast differentiation, bone formation, and skeletal homeostasis, with its dysregulation linked to osteoporosis and fracture non-union. Phytochemicals offer promising alternatives to unstable Wnt ligands, which risk tumorigenesis due to non-specific activation. In this study, we performed an extensive computational screening of selected phytochemicals-including quercetin, kaempferol, apigenin, genistein, gallic acid, ursolic acid, 2alpha-hydroxy ursolic acid, and berberine-previously reported to modulate the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway. These compounds, derived from diverse phytochemical classes including flavonoids, isoflavones, phenolic acids, triterpenoids, and alkaloids, have been shown in prior experimental studies to promote osteogenic responses by stabilizing beta-catenin, inhibiting GSK-3beta, and upregulating osteogenic genes such as Axin2 and cyclin D1. To complement these findings, we employed computational approaches, including gene-drug interaction analysis (DGIdb), structural similarity screening (Data Warrior, > 90% similarity to known drugs), and molecular docking (Maestro Schrodinger Suite), to predict high-affinity interactions with key regulatory proteins in the Wnt pathway. Our docking results revealed high binding affinities of phytochemicals to key targets that are involved in the modulation of the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway, such as Casein Kinase (CK, docking scores: -10.652 to -11.39), Estrogen Receptor (ER, docking score: -7.337 to -11.314), Vitamin D Receptor (VDR, docking score: -7.40 to -9.97), and GSK-3beta, with critical interactions involving residues like E305 and R346. Specifically, Caviunin glycoside from Dalbergia sissoo demonstrated estrogenic modulation within the ER ligand-binding domain (PDB ID: 1X7J; docking score: -5.29), supporting its role in osteoblast stimulation via ER-Wnt crosstalk. Structure-activity analyses identify flavanone glycosides and triterpenoids as promising scaffolds for medicinal chemistry optimization. Challenges, including poor bioavailability and off-target effects, necessitate advanced delivery systems and computational modeling to enhance selectivity and therapeutic utility, positioning these phytochemicals as viable leads for bone-related disorder treatments.
abstract_zh: Wnt/β-catenin信号通路对于成骨细胞分化、骨形成和骨骼稳态至关重要，其失调与骨质疏松症和骨折不愈合相关。植物化学物为不稳定的Wnt配体提供了有前景的替代方案，后者因非特异性激活而存在肿瘤发生风险。在本研究中，我们对选定的植物化学物——包括槲皮素 (quercetin)、山柰酚 (kaempferol)、芹菜素 (apigenin)、染料木黄酮 (genistein)、没食子酸 (gallic acid)、熊果酸 (ursolic acid)、2α-羟基熊果酸 (2alpha-hydroxy ursolic acid) 和小檗碱 (berberine)——进行了广泛的计算筛选，这些化合物此前被报道可调节Wnt/β-catenin通路。这些化合物源自多种植物化学类别，包括黄酮类 (flavonoids)、异黄酮类 (isoflavones)、酚酸类 (phenolic acids)、三萜类 (triterpenoids) 和生物碱类 (alkaloids)，先前实验研究已表明它们通过稳定β-catenin、抑制GSK-3β以及上调成骨基因（如Axin2和cyclin D1）来促进成骨反应。为补充这些发现，我们采用了计算方法，包括基因-药物相互作用分析 (DGIdb)、结构相似性筛选 (Data Warrior，与已知药物相似度>90%) 和分子对接 (Maestro Schrodinger Suite)，以预测与Wnt通路中关键调控蛋白的高亲和力相互作用。我们的对接结果显示，植物化学物对参与Wnt/β-catenin通路调节的关键靶点具有高结合亲和力，例如酪蛋白激酶 (Casein Kinase, CK，对接分数：-10.652至-11.39)、雌激素受体 (Estrogen Receptor, ER，对接分数：-7.337至-11.314)、维生素D受体 (Vitamin D Receptor, VDR，对接分数：-7.40至-9.97) 和GSK-3β，关键相互作用涉及E305和R346等残基。具体而言，来自印度黄檀 (Dalbergia sissoo) 的Caviunin糖苷在ER配体结合域 (PDB ID: 1X7J；对接分数：-5.29) 内表现出雌激素调节作用，支持其通过ER-Wnt串扰在成骨细胞刺激中的作用。结构-活性分析确定黄烷酮糖苷和三萜类为药物化学优化的有前景骨架。包括生物利用度差和脱靶效应在内的挑战，需要先进的递送系统和计算建模来增强选择性和治疗效用，将这些植物化学物定位为骨相关疾病治疗的有前景先导化合物。
